description: We are GADURA, a team of school friends passionate about space exploration, science, coding, and innovation. 🚀 We aim to work together in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to solve real-world problems using creativity, teamwork, technology, and NASA's open data. We welcome our school friends who are curious, enthusiastic, and ready to learn, share ideas, and build innovative solutions together. 🌍🛰️
summary:
ASTRA FRONTIER is an interactive digital space exploration platform developed by Team GADURA to make space science more engaging and accessible. It brings different aspects of space missions into one virtual environment, including Mission Control, crew and destination selection, astronaut habitats, life-support systems, Mars rover exploration, a Science Lab, Rookie Academy and Captain's Log.

The platform allows users to explore planetary environments, understand the challenges of human space missions and learn about space science through an interactive experience.

Our solution addresses the gap between theoretical space education and practical exploration by creating a connected, mission-based learning environment. We aim to encourage scientific curiosity, improve space-science awareness and inspire students to explore STEM fields.
details:
Project Overview

ASTRA FRONTIER is an interactive digital platform designed to introduce users to the different stages and systems involved in space exploration. Developed by Team GADURA, the project combines mission-based interaction, planetary exploration and educational content in one virtual environment.

How It Works

The experience begins with Mission Control, which acts as the entry point to the exploration environment. Users can explore crew and destination selection, including the Moon and Mars.

The platform includes several interconnected modules:

  • Mission Control: The main mission-entry environment.
  • Crew and Destination Selection: Introduces mission crew and planetary destination choices.
  • Habitat Systems: Explores astronaut habitats and life-support concepts.
  • Rover Operations: Provides a simulated Mars-like terrain for planetary surface exploration.
  • Science Lab: Provides a research-oriented scientific environment.
  • Rookie Academy: Introduces space-science learning for beginners.
  • Captain's Log: Provides a mission-record interface.

Benefits and Intended Impact

ASTRA FRONTIER makes complex space-related concepts easier to explore through an interactive digital experience. It encourages students to understand the relationship between mission planning, planetary environments, robotic exploration, astronaut survival and scientific investigation.

Its intended impact is to increase interest in astronomy, space technology and STEM education, particularly among school students.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of ASTRA FRONTIER is its combination of multiple space-exploration concepts within one connected environment. Rather than presenting space science only through static information, it creates a mission-oriented experience where users can navigate different exploration and learning modules.

Development Considerations

The project is developed as a digital software experience. Its design considers accessibility, ease of navigation, educational value and an engaging space-exploration atmosphere. The platform is intended to make space-related learning approachable for beginners while introducing concepts associated with real space missions.
